fusions.name: Pick at the Rivets
fusions.desc: Picks at the target's armour for 6 damage, leaving it 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds. It holds 4 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Anvil Chorus
fusions.desc: Spins with a cold weight in each fist, dealing 28 damage that ignores armour to every enemy within 3 tiles and leaving each [Leaden] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Hands Off the Goods
fusions.desc: For 5 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you. You move 20% faster for 4 seconds after using it.

fusions.name: Tempered by Near Misses
fusions.desc: Every time you dodge a blow, a stack builds on you, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 7% of your maximum health per stack (42% at full) before your health takes damage. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
